column1: # What the real-project lanes expect besides "every test that passes under
# status, census; oss-run.sh copies it beside its snapshot of the scripts).
# One entry per line, nine tab-separated columns, none empty:
# <target> aarch64, x86_64 or *; <flavour> O0, O0g or *; <mode> hod, strict
# or *. `fails`: the test fails in that build. <text>: `-`, or a string the
# test's output (the build's LastTest.log) must contain for the failure to
# be the one the entry describes; another failure stays a regression.
# A test that passes in the control and fails in the build is EXPECTED
# when an entry matches it (and its text); a build where the control fails
# too has no difference: the entry is moot there, not stale. The entry is
# STALE, and fails the summary like a regression, when the test passes in
# a build it matches or neither the control nor the build has the test;
# the list only shrinks by an edit.

column8: a call to an always_inline function is compiled out of line: the pc inline_func reads with `leaq 0(%rip)` is in inline_func, which the symbolizer names, not its caller; a difference where the control passes (native x86-64), none under qemu-x86_64 (the control fails too)
